content.intro_text: The character counter is a tool that works from typed text, calculating the amount of words, characters, sentences, lines and paragraphs. With a simple, easy and very common design, you just need to type or paste your text into the field above and ready, see the result next to it!
content.usage_title: How to Use the Character Counter
content.step_1: Type or paste copied content into the highlighted area above;
content.step_2: View the results on the right side of the field.
content.why_use_text: Besides being extremely easy and intuitive, a character counter can be very useful for tasks that would once have required a lot of effort. Try it out and share your results with us using the feedback tools, we'd love to hear what you think.
content.footer_text: Master text limits and optimize your posts with the Character Counter!
